title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
abstract: arXiv:2611.23247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. translated_title: 面向不确定决策阈值的预算化适度损失设计
translated_abstract: 二元概率估计可能被多个具有不同错误成本的决策者所使用。适当评分规则可以强调选定的概率阈值，但单一的平均阈值分布未必能提供良好的最坏情况遗憾保证。我们研究当阈值分布属于一个有限指定族时，如何选择适当损失。在具有逐点正下限且总质量固定的可积损失权重中，我们推导出了使从代理遗憾到阈值平均决策遗憾的锐利、无分布乘数最小化的权重。该解在规定的下限处对阈值密度的重标度上包络线进行截断，其归一化通过一维求根搜索得到。我们给出了锐利性、最优性以及密度误设下稳定性的证明，并指出了原子阈值定律下的一个局限性。精确的直方图实现和两个合成实验（验证了理论结果）。
tldr: 本文在阈值分布属于有限指定族的设定下，推导出使代理遗憾到阈值平均决策遗憾的最坏情况乘数最小化的最优适度损失权重——即在规定下限处截断阈值密度的重标度上包络线，并证明了其锐利性、最优性与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the budgeted proper loss weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free worst-case multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret, given by clipping a rescaled upper envelope of threshold densities at a prescribed floor, with proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability.
